# Full Context: K-Dev Notes

> Detailed technical reference guides, code patterns, and architectural writeups authored by Kamran Khan (@kamranxdev).

## Platform Overview

- [K-Dev Notes Application](https://notes.kamranx.dev): Canonical documentation entry point.
- [Creator Portfolio](https://kamranx.dev): Developer portfolio website.
- **Author / Developer**: Kamran Khan (@kamranxdev)
- **Primary Domain**: https://notes.kamranx.dev

K-Dev Notes provides structured documentation, code examples, system design patterns, and Computer Science concepts for developers.

## Categories & Topics Covered

1. **Frontend Engineering**: React 19, Next.js App Router, Server Components, State Management, Core Web Vitals.
2. **Backend Engineering**: Node.js, Express, Microservices Architecture, REST & GraphQL APIs, Database Indexing.
3. **Algorithms & System Design**: DSA Cheat Sheets, Scalability Patterns, High Availability, Distributed Systems.
4. **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Edge Compute.
